description_en: Apartment for sale, suitable for a hotel, 7 bedrooms, 1 staff room, 8 toilets, 2 small warehouses, 240 m2 net, 310 m2 gross. In work for 7 years, average monthly turnover 6000-8000 euros, contemporary regular investment, located on the 9th floor of a new building, elevator with chip programmed only on the floor of the rooms. The environment can be adapted for offices or call centers, south-east view. Address: At the beginning of Kavaje street, behind Raiffeisen Bank, the new building, built by Nova Construction. Price 1,150,000 euros Negotiable. Currently rented for €3,400 net, 5-year contract
